integration_gates.delivery_goal: Deliver the complete protocol-neutral public harness.oac.dev/v1 SDK boundary with typed Describe, execute, observe, cancel, result, and error unions; preserve exact Package/entrypoint, Extension/binding, operation, owner, subject, scope, request digest, and service payload digest through every public binding path. Remove every public authority constructor that lets a caller choose both Host signing and trust verification inputs, and expose only the package-neutral consumer/verification side of opaque service and Gate handoffs. The SDK must define a usable Host-facing ingress contract without implementing the Host producer: arbitrary callers and ExtensionPackages must be unable to mint an authoritative RequestScope, GateEvaluatorBinding, receipt, or evaluator invocation. Replace the obsolete missing-symbol regression with a structurally valid attempt against the current public API and prove zero binding, receipt, and evaluator calls. Remove all SDK-owned or same-package test-only Host authority bridges. Every SDK-local fixture must emit source-revision-bound measured evidence for its exact scoped assertion; the Gate consumer row may pass only by proving the negative boundary, must report registered_gate_positive_path_count=0 and authoritative_gate_positive_claim_count=0, and must identify its scope as sdk-boundary rather than representing full Host-backed Gate conformance. Produce harness-sdk-boundary-evidence for the downstream harness-host producer. Preserve typed operation-schema validation, successful Trigger/EventHandler, bounded offline schema resolution, Required/Optional behavior, Unknown recovery, safe retry/cancel, coverage, race, vet, and deterministic sdk/harness packaging. The mandatory genuine Host-installed positive path and final combined semantic verdict remain downstream responsibilities of harness-host and contracts-extension. SDK-local positive operation conformance is not Host authorization: the fixed SDK conformance runner may execute ordinary typed Describe/Guide/Sensor/Executor/Trigger/EventHandler implementations with deterministic, non-authoritative request data and the same production input/response/schema/outcome validation and receipt-classification code. Its measured conformance records must be explicitly scoped sdk-operation-conformance, must not construct trusted RequestScope, service/Gate handoffs or authoritative receipts, and must never be usable by production authority entry points. A helper-only predicate or direct implementation call that bypasses the shared validation/measurement path is insufficient. Preserve successful Trigger output and all three successful EventHandler lifecycle operations; error-only implementations must fail these positive fixtures. Production typed Guide/Sensor/Trigger/EventHandler paths must finish response and output-schema validation before accepting a receipt; invalid results yield rejected/failed measured outcomes, while valid business-error envelopes retain a separate failed business outcome and never count as positive operation success. Optional side-effecting failures may become skipped only when the external failure outcome is known; structured Unknown and unstructured errors remain Unknown and require observation/recovery. SDK service/Gate rows are exclusively sdk-consumer-negative: reject even internally consistent caller handoffs without issuing a binding, authoritative receipt, or implementation/evaluator call. Envelope, rotation, replay, payload and identity assertions in these rows prove rejection of untrusted candidates, not authentication or durable replay enforcement. The Host-facing ingress contract must be package-neutral and implementable by the separately owned harness-host producer, not an unconditional rejecting stub or a caller-selectable verifier; document the exact release/entrypoint, binding, operation, owner, subject, scope, request/service-payload digest, component/run, policy and evaluator identity handoff. Host-owned verification, configured trust, expiry/rotation and replay enforcement remain in harness-host. The existing downstream dependency harness-host consumes harness-sdk-boundary-evidence and produces harness-host-gate-evidence at artifacts/harness-host/gate-evidence.json; contracts-extension consumes both and emits contracts-extension-final-conformance. Genuine service/Gate acceptance, authenticated handoff transport, accepted-then-replayed rejection across receivers/restart and genuine key rotation are mandatory Host conformance within that artifact, not SDK-local metrics or SDK prerequisites. Mark those downstream obligations not-run in SDK evidence, never passed, and do not add a reverse dependency. The three newly required regression test names are authoring deliverables, not claims of existing passing tests: TestHarnessSDKTypedResponseValidationPrecedesReceiptAcceptance measures malformed response and output-schema violation for both Guide points, both Sensor points, Trigger, and EventHandler execute/observe/cancel (16 rejected results), plus a valid business-error envelope for each of those eight paths without false business success. TestHarnessSDKOptionalUnknownFailureRequiresObservation measures structured outcome_known=false and unstructured errors, retains Unknown without skipped Observation or retry permission, and preserves Required blocking/known Optional failure observations. TestHarnessSDKConformanceEvidenceCannotAuthorizeHostIngress submits actual fixed-runner measurements/request data to the current production service/Gate boundary and proves no authority, bindings, authoritative receipts or implementation/evaluator calls. Keep these child executions in the existing typed-point-describe-contracts, required-optional-failure-policy and service/Gate consumer rows; the fixed selector still has exactly 13 measured semantic rows and seven current-amendment rows. No new row may be faked from test-name presence. Ordinary operation rows carry actual implementation call/result and validator/receipt-classification evidence with full target/operation/provenance identity; service cases are the 15 fixed case IDs checked by the gate. All exact counters derive from those actual parent/child executions, and forbidden-call counters count only calls forbidden for that assertion, not legitimate calls in ordinary positive fixtures. Staged coverage policy, effective only after explicit human acceptance of this amendment: SDK-only raw unfiltered statement coverage must be at least 85%; this does not waive the whole-SDK 90% gate now required of downstream harness-host. Do not filter profiles, change coverage scope, pad the denominator, delete required behavior, manufacture Host proof, or move production code between owners to meet a percentage. Add real coverage of ordinary production-used paths and execute the exact reordered commands: broad coverage/vet/race runs first, reset the conformance log, execute every fixed boundary selector, then generate and validate the final 50-test/13-row semantic evidence once. Keep genuine Host conformance not-run in SDK evidence. Do not submit failing work as successful or advance review/merge/downstream acceptance without every unchanged gate passing. The SDK must define a usable Host-facing ingress contract without implementing the Host producer: arbitrary callers and ExtensionPackages must be unable to mint an authoritative RequestScope, GateEvaluatorBinding, receipt, or evaluator invocation. Replace the obsolete missing-symbol regression with a structurally valid attempt against the current public API and prove zero binding, receipt, and evaluator calls. Remove all SDK-owned or same-package test-only Host authority bridges. Every SDK-local fixture must emit source-revision-bound measured evidence for its exact scoped assertion; the Gate consumer row may pass only by proving the negative boundary, must report registered_gate_positive_path_count=0 and authoritative_gate_positive_claim_count=0, and must identify its scope as sdk-boundary rather than representing full Host-backed Gate conformance. Produce harness-sdk-boundary-evidence for the downstream harness-host producer. Preserve typed operation-schema validation, successful Trigger/EventHandler, bounded offline schema resolution, Required/Optional behavior, Unknown recovery, safe retry/cancel, coverage, race, vet, and deterministic sdk/harness packaging. The mandatory genuine Host-installed positive path and final combined semantic verdict remain downstream responsibilities of harness-host and contracts-extension. SDK-local positive operation conformance is not Host authorization: the fixed SDK conformance runner may execute ordinary typed Describe/Guide/Sensor/Executor/Trigger/EventHandler implementations with deterministic, non-authoritative request data and the same production input/response/schema/outcome validation and receipt-classification code. Its measured conformance records must be explicitly scoped sdk-operation-conformance, must not construct trusted RequestScope, service/Gate handoffs or authoritative receipts, and must never be usable by production authority entry points. A helper-only predicate or direct implementation call that bypasses the shared validation/measurement path is insufficient. Preserve successful Trigger output and all three successful EventHandler lifecycle operations; error-only implementations must fail these positive fixtures. Production typed Guide/Sensor/Trigger/EventHandler paths must finish response and output-schema validation before accepting a receipt; invalid results yield rejected/failed measured outcomes, while valid business-error envelopes retain a separate failed business outcome and never count as positive operation success. Optional side-effecting failures may become skipped only when the external failure outcome is known; structured Unknown and unstructured errors remain Unknown and require observation/recovery.
